hypothesis: In source-related tasks, induction of an operator from examples followed by reuse yields higher hidden accuracy than target-only feedback search with equal candidate counts.
primary_contrast: REUSE - TARGET_ONLY on RELATED hidden9 exact-vector accuracy
uncertainty: Paired cluster bootstrap on 40 confirmation episodes, 6000 replicates; 95% percentile interval; 0 included => inconclusive
acceptance: Honest reporting; no pre-claim of positive result; no use of hidden outputs in policies
limits: No new fundamental primitive; operator assembled from pre-defined arithmetic and neighbor/index grammar; cost matched by source/target proposal evaluations not exact CPU time; internal oracle, not external judge; no neural agent.
additional_baseline_note: STRUCTURED solves known grammar with modular linear algebra. Same 216 source and 64 target candidate evaluations, but different computational overhead. No claim of equal CPU.
